issue.title: Email alerts toggle does not stay off after reopening Settings
issue.body:
## Summary
Toggling 'Email alerts' off does not persist after navigating back and reopening Settings.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Open Settings > Notifications.
2. Toggle 'Email alerts' off.
3. Go back.
4. Reopen Settings.

## Expected Behavior
The toggle should stay off.

## Actual Behavior
The toggle is on again.

## Environment
- App version: v2.4.1
- OS: Android 14
- Device: Pixel 8

## Additional Notes
Reproduces consistently (happens every time).

issue.title: 'Email alerts' toggle reverts to on after leaving Settings
issue.body:
## Summary
Toggling 'Email alerts' off in notification settings does not persist. After navigating away and returning, the setting is found toggled on again.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Open Settings > Notifications.
2. Toggle 'Email alerts' off.
3. Navigate back.
4. Reopen Settings.

## Expected Behavior
The 'Email alerts' toggle should stay off.

## Actual Behavior
The 'Email alerts' toggle reverts to on.

## Environment
- OS: Android 14
- App Version: v2.4.1
- Device: Pixel 8

## Additional Notes
- Frequency: always
- Assumptions: Assumed the user navigated back into Notifications upon reopening Settings to observe the toggle state.
